description: Semantic vector search over 787daily's Puerto Rico news corpus. Returns the most relevant article matches (title, URL, topic, date, score) for a free-text query — without generating an answer. Use this when you want matching articles rather than a synthesized answer. Every url is absolute. (Written answers for people are at https://787daily.com/ask; there is no answer tool here.)

query.description: Free-text question or topic to search for

name: search_news
